name: Why does my entire house smell like sewer gas?

mainEntity.name: Why does my entire house smell like sewer gas?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the sewer gas smell permeates your entire house, it often indicates a more widespread issue than a single dry drain. Potential causes include a main sewer line clog that's backing up gases, a severely damaged or cracked sewer pipe within your foundation, or a problem with the main plumbing vent stack for your home. Such widespread odors require immediate professional attention to protect indoor air quality and prevent further damage. A plumber can perform diagnostics like smoke testing to locate the source.
acceptedAnswer.description: A whole-house sewer gas smell suggests a serious issue like a main sewer line problem or a damaged vent stack, requiring immediate professional help.
